threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still try to catch the bus at a stop instead of just walking to the nearest one. Proper locals know it’s all about the shortcuts.
Caught the 45 last Friday, and the driver had the smoothest playlist. Even the usual rowdy crowd was singing along by the time we hit Brixton Hill.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids trading Pokémon cards outside my local Späti while a stray cat lounged in the sun. That’s Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can order a beer at most U-Bahn stations, but in Friedrichshain, it’s the unspoken rule to grab a currywurst while you wait for your train.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know you're from here when you can name the bus routes that always get delayed. It’s not just bad luck; it’s the 14 and 49 in a nutshell.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tutu juggling bananas on the 14 line today. Only in SF does the Muni stage feel like a mini circus amid rush hour chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all the cats on the streets are stray, but most have owners living just around the corner. They’re part of our community.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewildered look at the metro’s ticket machines—everyone else seems to know the quirks already.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still flinch when someone asks for a 'full English' and don’t realize it's just the breakfast, not a new social contract.
Last night on the 59, a guy serenaded the whole bus with classic soul. Just as we pulled into Brixton, he belted out 'Ain't No Mountain High Enough'—proper vibes.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a toddler riding a tricycle while their grandma haggled over prices at the Turkish market. Pure Neukölln vibe.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can find spontaneous open-air cinema in the parks during summer. Just bring your own chair and snacks, and it feels like a block party every time.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how they handle the BART delays; we just roll our eyes and keep scrolling Twitter, while newcomers panic at every loud bang.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today with a man arguing with himself about the weather; had a surprising clarity in the chaos of the Tenderloin's fog.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about Gaudí. Miss the tastiest bocadillos in the hidden bars where locals actually hang out.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewilderment at the ferocity of the pickpockets on the metro during rush hour—it's a rite of passage.
